messages:
maya: FYI new canary for olive-lite9b int4 hit OOMs on prefix-heavy chat. Repro in CI.

trent: Can you paste the last error?

maya: ```
2026-03-20T21:03:02Z ERROR inference: alloc failed during kv prefetch
prefix length ~120 tokens, max_new_tokens=480, prefetch_pages=200 -> mem spike
```

ops-bot: Canary rolled back: olive-lite9b-int4-v2 on pool-gpu-b.

soren: Looks like fragmentation + large prefetch + big max_new_tokens default. Int4 reduces model size but not transient KV growth.

trent: Quick local numbers: defaults -> 430 qps, p95 76ms, OOMs 3/hr. With prefetch=48 and max_new_tokens=128 -> 395 qps, p95 84ms, OOMs 0.

maya: Proposed short-term: set prefetch_pages=48, max_new_tokens_default=128, enable post-warm compaction, soft-kv-trim=0.85.

soren: Config override for canary:
model: olive-lite9b-int4-v2
serve_preset:
  prefetch_pages: 48
  max_new_tokens_default: 128
  warmstart_compact: true
  kv_trim_threshold: 0.85
  batch: {max_batch_tokens: 4096}

maya: Added small warmup to trigger compaction after 20 warm requests.

trent: With override + warmup: steady qps 380, p95 88ms, mem headroom +16%, OOMs 0. Eval pass shows no quality drop on our rouge/qa checks.

bench-bot: Bench report https://bench.redwood/olive-lite9b/1759991112: throughput -11%, p95 +12ms, mem-95 -20%.

soren: Agree to push as temporary default for this model. Long-term: improve allocator/kernels and implement workload-aware prefetch.

maya: Filed INF-5483 for allocator investigation and follow-up experiments. Pushing override to canary now.

trent: I'll monitor OOM rate and p95 for 24h and set alert at 2 OOMs/hour.

maya: Thanks all. Will update after 24h. :thumbsup:
